verses.original: Ὄφελον ἀνείχεσθέ τι μικρόν μου ἀφροσύνης ἀλλὰ καὶ ἀνέχεσθέ μου
verses.transliteration: Ophelon aneichesthe ti mikron mou aphrosynēs alla kai anechesthe mou
verses.literal: I hope you will put up with a little of my foolishness but . . . [you are already doing that] . . .

verses.original: γὰρ ζηλῶ ὑμᾶς Θεοῦ ζήλῳ γὰρ ἡρμοσάμην ὑμᾶς ἑνὶ ἀνδρὶ παραστῆσαι ἁγνὴν παρθένον τῷ Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: gar zēlō hymas Theou zēlō gar hērmosamēn hymas heni andri parastēsai hagnēn parthenon tō Christō
verses.literal: - I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy For I promised you to one husband to present [you] [as] a pure virgin - to Christ

verses.original: Φοβοῦμαι μή δὲ πως ὡς Εὕαν ἐξηπάτησεν ἐν ὁ ὄφις αὐτοῦ τῇ πανουργίᾳ ὑμῶν τὰ νοήματα φθαρῇ ἀπὸ τῆς ἁπλότητος καὶ τῆς ἁγνότητος τῆς εἰς τὸν Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: Phoboumai mē de pōs hōs Heuan exēpatēsen en ho ophis autou tē panourgia hymōn ta noēmata phtharē apo tēs haplotētos kai tēs hagnotētos tēs eis ton Christon
verses.literal: I am afraid - however that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s - - cunning your - minds may be led astray from [your] simple and - pure [devotion] - to - Christ

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ μὲν ὁ ἐρχόμενος κηρύσσει Ἰησοῦν ἄλλον ὃν οὐκ ἐκηρύξαμεν ἢ λαμβάνετε ἕτερον πνεῦμα ὃ οὐκ ἐλάβετε ἢ ἕτερον εὐαγγέλιον ὃ οὐκ ἐδέξασθε ἀνέχεσθε καλῶς
verses.transliteration: gar ei men ho erchomenos kēryssei Iēsoun allon hon ouk ekēryxamen ē lambanete heteron pneuma ho ouk elabete ē heteron euangelion ho ouk edexasthe anechesthe kalōs
verses.literal: For if - [someone] comes [and] proclaims [a] Jesus other [than the One] . . . we proclaimed or if you receive a different spirit [than the One] . . . you received or a different gospel [than the one] . . . you accepted you put up with it very easily

verses.original: γὰρ Λογίζομαι μηδὲν ὑστερηκέναι τῶν Ὑπερλίαν ἀποστόλων
verses.transliteration: gar Logizomai mēden hysterēkenai tōn Hyperlian apostolōn
verses.literal: - I consider myself in no way inferior to those super-apostles . . .

verses.original: δὲ καὶ εἰ ἰδιώτης τῷ λόγῳ ἀλλ’ οὐ τῇ γνώσει ἀλλ’ φανερώσαντες εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν παντὶ ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: de kai ei idiōtēs tō logō all’ ou tē gnōsei all’ phanerōsantes eis hymas en panti en pasin
verses.literal: - Although . . . [I am] not a polished - speaker vvv I am certainly not lacking - in knowledge - We have made this clear to you in every way possible . . . . . .

verses.original: Ἢ ἁμαρτίαν ἐποίησα ταπεινῶν ἐμαυτὸν ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑψωθῆτε ὅτι εὐηγγελισάμην τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμῖν δωρεὰν
verses.transliteration: Ē hamartian epoiēsa tapeinōn emauton hina hymeis hypsōthēte hoti euēngelisamēn to euangelion tou Theou hymin dōrean
verses.literal: [Was it] a sin [for me] to humble myself in order to vvv exalt you because I preached the gospel - of God to you free of charge

verses.original: ἐσύλησα ἄλλας ἐκκλησίας λαβὼν ὀψώνιον πρὸς τὴν διακονίαν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: esylēsa allas ekklēsias labōn opsōnion pros tēn diakonian hymōn
verses.literal: I robbed other churches by accepting [their] support in order - to serve you

verses.original: καὶ παρὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑστερηθεὶς οὐ κατενάρκησα οὐθενός γὰρ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἐλθόντες ἀπὸ Μακεδονίας προσανεπλήρωσαν μου τὸ ὑστέρημά καὶ ἐτήρησα ἐμαυτὸν ἀβαρῆ ὑμῖν ἐν παντὶ καὶ τηρήσω
verses.transliteration: kai parōn pros hymas kai hysterētheis ou katenarkēsa outhenos gar hoi adelphoi elthontes apo Makedonias prosaneplērōsan mou to hysterēma kai etērēsa emauton abarē hymin en panti kai tērēsō
verses.literal: And when I was with you and in need vvv I was not a burden [to anyone] for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my - needs - I have refrained . . . from being a burden to you in any way and I will continue to do so

verses.original: ἀλήθεια Χριστοῦ ἔστιν ἐν ἐμοὶ ὅτι αὕτη ἡ καύχησις εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ φραγήσεται ἐν τοῖς κλίμασιν τῆς Ἀχαΐας
verses.transliteration: alētheia Christou estin en emoi hoti hautē hē kauchēsis eis eme ou phragēsetai en tois klimasin tēs Achaias
verses.literal: [As surely as the] truth of Christ is in me - this - boasting of mine vvv will not be silenced in the regions - of Achaia

verses.original: διὰ τί ὅτι οὐκ ἀγαπῶ ὑμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς οἶδεν
verses.transliteration: dia ti hoti ouk agapō hymas ho Theos oiden
verses.literal: Why . . . Because vvv I do not love you - God knows [I do]

verses.original: δὲ καὶ ποιήσω Ὃ ποιῶ ἵνα ἐκκόψω τὴν ἀφορμὴν τῶν θελόντων ἀφορμήν ἵνα εὑρεθῶσιν καθὼς καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐν ᾧ καυχῶνται
verses.transliteration: de kai poiēsō Ho poiō hina ekkopsō tēn aphormēn tōn thelontōn aphormēn hina heurethōsin kathōs kai hēmeis en hō kauchōntai
verses.literal: But vvv I will keep on doing what I am doing in order to undercut - - those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals . . . . . . in the things of which they boast

verses.original: γὰρ οἱ τοιοῦτοι ψευδαπόστολοι δόλιοι ἐργάται μετασχηματιζόμενοι εἰς ἀποστόλους Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar hoi toioutoi pseudapostoloi dolioi ergatai metaschēmatizomenoi eis apostolous Christou
verses.literal: For - such men [are] false apostles deceitful workers masquerading as apostles of Christ

verses.original: καὶ οὐ θαῦμα γὰρ ὁ Σατανᾶς αὐτὸς μετασχηματίζεται εἰς ἄγγελον φωτός
verses.transliteration: kai ou thauma gar ho Satanas autos metaschēmatizetai eis angelon phōtos
verses.literal: And no wonder for - Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light

verses.original: οὐ μέγα οὖν εἰ αὐτοῦ οἱ διάκονοι καὶ μετασχηματίζονται ὡς διάκονοι δικαιοσύνης ὧν τὸ τέλος ἔσται κατὰ αὐτῶν τὰ ἔργα
verses.transliteration: ou mega oun ei autou hoi diakonoi kai metaschēmatizontai hōs diakonoi dikaiosynēs hōn to telos estai kata autōn ta erga
verses.literal: [It is] not surprising then if his - servants - masquerade as servants of righteousness [Their] - end will correspond to . . . their - actions

verses.original: Πάλιν λέγω μή τίς δόξῃ με εἶναι ἄφρονα δὲ εἰ μή¦γε δέξασθέ με κἂν ὡς ἄφρονα ἵνα κἀγὼ καυχήσωμαι τι μικρόν
verses.transliteration: Palin legō mē tis doxē me einai aphrona de ei mē¦ge dexasthe me kan hōs aphrona hina kagō kauchēsōmai ti mikron
verses.literal: vvv I repeat {Let} no one take me for a fool But if [you do] [then] receive me - as a fool so that I too may boast a little

verses.original: ὃ λαλῶ ἐν ταύτῃ τῆς ὑποστάσει τῇ καυχήσεως οὐ λαλῶ κατὰ Κύριον ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ
verses.transliteration: ho lalō en tautē tēs hypostasei tē kauchēseōs ou lalō kata Kyrion all’ hōs en aphrosynē
verses.literal: - - In this - confident - boasting [of mine] vvv I am not speaking as [the] Lord {would} but as - a fool

verses.original: ἐπεὶ πολλοὶ καυχῶνται κατὰ τὴν σάρκα κἀγὼ καυχήσομαι
verses.transliteration: epei polloi kauchōntai kata tēn sarka kagō kauchēsomai
verses.literal: Since many are boasting according to the flesh I too will boast

verses.original: γὰρ ἀνέχεσθε ἡδέως τῶν ἀφρόνων ὄντες φρόνιμοι
verses.transliteration: gar anechesthe hēdeōs tōn aphronōn ontes phronimoi
verses.literal: For you gladly put up with . . . - fools since you are so wise

verses.original: γὰρ ἀνέχεσθε εἴ τις καταδουλοῖ ὑμᾶς εἴ τις κατεσθίει εἴ τις λαμβάνει εἴ τις ἐπαίρεται εἴ τις δέρει ὑμᾶς εἰς πρόσωπον
verses.transliteration: gar anechesthe ei tis katadouloi hymas ei tis katesthiei ei tis lambanei ei tis epairetai ei tis derei hymas eis prosōpon
verses.literal: In fact you even put up with - anyone who enslaves you [or] . . . exploits [you] [or] . . . takes advantage [of you] [or] . . . exalts himself [or] . . . strikes you in the face

verses.original: κατὰ ἀτιμίαν λέγω ὡς ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠσθενήκαμεν λέγω ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ δ’ κἀγώ τολμῶ Ἐν ᾧ τις ἄν τολμᾷ
verses.transliteration: kata atimian legō hōs hoti hēmeis ēsthenēkamen legō en aphrosynē d’ kagō tolmō En hō tis an tolma
verses.literal: To [my] shame I concede - that we were too weak [for that] Speaking vvv as a fool however I can [match] - what anyone else . . . dares [to boast about]

verses.original: εἰσιν Ἑβραῖοί κἀγώ εἰσιν Ἰσραηλῖταί κἀγώ εἰσιν σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ κἀγώ
verses.transliteration: eisin Hebraioi kagō eisin Israēlitai kagō eisin sperma Abraam kagō
verses.literal: Are they Hebrews So am I Are they Israelites So am I Are they descendants of Abraham So am I

verses.original: εἰσιν διάκονοι Χριστοῦ λαλῶ παραφρονῶν ἐγώ ὑπὲρ ἐν περισσοτέρως κόποις ἐν περισσοτέρως φυλακαῖς ἐν ὑπερβαλλόντως πληγαῖς ἐν πολλάκις θανάτοις
verses.transliteration: eisin diakonoi Christou lalō paraphronōn egō hyper en perissoterōs kopois en perissoterōs phylakais en hyperballontōs plēgais en pollakis thanatois
verses.literal: Are they servants of Christ I am speaking as if I were out of my mind I am so much more in harder labor in more imprisonments in worse beatings in frequent danger of death

verses.original: πεντάκις ἔλαβον Ὑπὸ Ἰουδαίων τεσσεράκοντα παρὰ μίαν
verses.transliteration: pentakis elabon Hypo Ioudaiōn tesserakonta para mian
verses.literal: Five times I received from [the] Jews [the] forty [lashes] minus one

verses.original: τρὶς ἐραβδίσθην ἅπαξ ἐλιθάσθην τρὶς ἐναυάγησα πεποίηκα νυχθήμερον ἐν τῷ βυθῷ
verses.transliteration: tris erabdisthēn hapax elithasthēn tris enauagēsa pepoiēka nychthēmeron en tō bythō
verses.literal: Three times I was beaten with rods once I was stoned three times I was shipwrecked I spent a night and a day in the open [sea]

verses.original: ὁδοιπορίαις πολλάκις κινδύνοις ποταμῶν κινδύνοις λῃστῶν κινδύνοις ἐκ γένους κινδύνοις ἐξ ἐθνῶν κινδύνοις ἐν πόλει κινδύνοις ἐν ἐρημίᾳ κινδύνοις ἐν θαλάσσῃ κινδύνοις ἐν ψευδαδέλφοις
verses.transliteration: hodoiporiais pollakis kindynois potamōn kindynois lēstōn kindynois ek genous kindynois ex ethnōn kindynois en polei kindynois en erēmia kindynois en thalassē kindynois en pseudadelphois
verses.literal: In my frequent journeys . . . [I have been] in danger from rivers [and] from bandits in danger from [my] countrymen [and] from [the] Gentiles in danger in [the] city [and] in [the] country in danger on [the] sea [and] among false brothers

verses.original: κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ πολλάκις ἐν ἀγρυπνίαις ἐν λιμῷ καὶ δίψει πολλάκις ἐν νηστείαις ἐν ψύχει καὶ γυμνότητι
verses.transliteration: kopō kai mochthō pollakis en agrypniais en limō kai dipsei pollakis en nēsteiais en psychei kai gymnotēti
verses.literal: in labor and toil [and] often vvv without sleep in hunger and thirst [and] often vvv without food in cold and exposure

verses.original: Χωρὶς παρεκτὸς τῶν μοι καθ’ ἡ ἡμέραν ἡ ἐπίστασίς ἡ μέριμνα πασῶν τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν
verses.transliteration: Chōris parektos tōn moi kath’ hē hēmeran hē epistasis hē merimna pasōn tōn ekklēsiōn
verses.literal: Apart from these external [trials] I [face] vvv vvv daily the pressure [of my] concern for all the churches

verses.original: τίς ἀσθενεῖ καὶ οὐκ ἀσθενῶ τίς σκανδαλίζεται καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ πυροῦμαι
verses.transliteration: tis asthenei kai ouk asthenō tis skandalizetai kai egō ouk pyroumai
verses.literal: Who is weak and vvv I am not weak Who is led into sin and I {do} not burn with grief

verses.original: Εἰ δεῖ καυχᾶσθαι καυχήσομαι τὰ τῆς μου ἀσθενείας
verses.transliteration: Ei dei kauchasthai kauchēsomai ta tēs mou astheneias
verses.literal: If I must boast I will boast [of] the things [that show] my weakness

verses.original: ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ὁ ὢν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας εὐλογητὸς οἶδεν ὅτι οὐ ψεύδομαι
verses.transliteration: ho Theos kai Patēr tou Kyriou Iēsou ho ōn eis tous aiōnas eulogētos oiden hoti ou pseudomai
verses.literal: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus who is vvv vvv forever worthy of praise knows that vvv I am not lying

verses.original: ἐν Δαμασκῷ ὁ ἐθνάρχης τοῦ βασιλέως Ἁρέτα ἐφρούρει τὴν πόλιν Δαμασκηνῶν πιάσαι με
verses.transliteration: en Damaskō ho ethnarchēs tou basileōs Hareta ephrourei tēn polin Damaskēnōn piasai me
verses.literal: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me

verses.original: καὶ ἐχαλάσθην ἐν σαργάνῃ διὰ θυρίδος διὰ τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἐξέφυγον αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας
verses.transliteration: kai echalasthēn en sarganē dia thyridos dia tou teichous kai exephygon autou tas cheiras
verses.literal: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his - grasp
